text: {"lessons":["My account rose substantially overall, but the month-to-month swings show I should measure progress toward my apartment goal over years, not react to one month’s return.","Selling Stock C at a loss and later buying more taught me to base each trade on a clear view of its prospects and portfolio role—not on its recent price or my cost basis.","I should review all five holdings together and avoid selling a stock just because it has gained or buying one just because it has fallen; holding steady is also a valid choice when my plan hasn’t changed."]}
